data.description: 【森蚺 · 河湾】萨贡雨林清凉见底的天然河湾浅滩上，森蚺赤脚站在齐膝深的溪水中，强壮有力的粗长鳄尾在水面猛地一摆拍击出漫天晶莹的水花。她转过头冲岸边的你爽朗大笑——「雨林里的河水最解暑了！博士别站在岸上干看着，快跳下来和我一起游泳抓鱼！」
data.promptProse: Eunectes stands knee-deep in the clear rainforest river, laughing and waving toward the bank as her crocodilian tail sweeps a curtain of droplets sideways. Green halter top, tactical vest and leather shorts remain above the water, with her heavy work boots submerged. The medium view connects tail splash to stones visible in the shallows. Afternoon sun through the canopy catches the spray and ripples, casting leaf shadows across the deeper riverbed.
data.title: 森蚺 · 河湾
